meta.title: Sign in
meta.description: Sign in to mdstore, or create a free account, to post your prompts.

leads.signUp: A free account lets you post your prompts on mdstore.
leads.signIn: Welcome back. Sign in to post your prompts.

auth.usernameHint: Shown as @username on your posts and reviews. 2 to 39 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores. You can change it later from your profile, once every 30 days.

guidance.usernameFormat: Use 2 to 39 letters, numbers, dots (.), dashes (-) or underscores (_), with no spaces.
guidance.usernameTaken: This username is taken. Try another one.
guidance.passwordUnchanged: Use a password different from your current one.

pickUsername.title: Pick your username
pickUsername.lead: Posts, reviews and comments show your @username. Pick one to continue; you can change it later from your profile.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.notConfigured: Accounts aren’t available yet. Please try again later.
errors.alreadySet: Your account already has a username. Reload the page to continue.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, quote this code: {requestId}.

password.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the password. Select it and copy it by hand.

results.checkEmail: Almost done: we sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first: open the link we sent you, then sign in.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in instead.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.fixFields: Some fields need a change. They’re marked below.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, quote this code: {requestId}.
errors.notConfigured: Accounts aren’t available yet. Please try again later.
errors.confirmFailed: That confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Sign in to get a new one, or create your account again.
